intro: In a Ratchathewi neighbourhood full of standard box hotels, White Palace Hotel Bangkok stands out as one of the very few places where you can sit on your own private balcony · the 4-star boutique at 40 Soi Petchburi 15 comes with an outdoor swimming pool and free in-building parking — two things that are genuinely hard to find at this price in central Bangkok · it is 1.1 km from Rajavithi Hospital and the Children's Hospital next door, a 6-minute drive or roughly a 15-minute walk along the road · the hotel sits within easy reach of Victory Monument and Pratunam for meals and errands · prices from approx. ฿1,280/night, scored 7.9 from 176 reviews on Trip.com

body.html: Who White Palace suits — the clearest way to put it: this hotel is built for people visiting Rajavithi Hospital or the Queen Sirikit National Institute of Child Health (the Children's Hospital) who want something more than a bare-bones sleep between hospital runs · the private balconies, outdoor pool, and free parking put it in a rare bracket — a place where a family travelling with a patient can actually unwind, park a car at no extra cost, and have a balcony to sit on in the evenings · it is not a brand-new designer property with pristine finishes in every corner, and it does not pretend to be · what it offers is generous room sizes, genuine character, and a location that keeps daily logistics simple: Grab to the hospital in minutes, food at Victory Monument a short walk away, BTS for longer trips across the city · real reviews consistently point to the same group of happy guests — families who drove in, parties of two or three sharing a Triple with Balcony, and longer-stay visitors who wanted a pool and parking rather than just the cheapest room on the block.

Getting to Rajavithi Hospital from here — the hotel is at 40 Soi Petchburi 15, Ratchathewi District, 1.1 km from Rajavithi Hospital and the adjacent Children's Hospital on Ratchawithi Road · most guests take a Grab or taxi for the roughly 6-minute ride — fast and easy, especially with a patient or equipment in tow · if you prefer to walk, the route along Ratchawithi Road takes about 15 minutes on foot · for those driving in, the hotel's free in-building parking means you never need to hunt for a space, then you drive over to the hospital campus each morning at no extra cost · for wider travel, BTS Victory Monument station is about 1 km away (12-minute walk) and connects to the Silom Line; BTS Phaya Thai a bit further links to the Airport Rail Link straight to Suvarnabhumi · a note on navigating Rajavithi itself: it is a large multi-building campus, so check which building or clinic you need before you go — walking across the grounds can add several minutes on top of your drive.

"We brought mum here for two weeks of treatment at Rajavithi. Chose White Palace because of the free parking and the pool — parked the car in the garage, drove to the hospital each morning, came back and used the pool in the evening. The room had a balcony too, which made the whole stay feel much more bearable."

Rooms and balconies — this is the detail that separates White Palace from almost everything else in the same price range in this neighbourhood · across 97 rooms on 9 floors, many come with a private balcony that looks out over the city — a feature you almost never find at this price point in Bangkok · the entry tier is the Superior Room, a decent-sized room with a work desk, TV, mini fridge, kettle, and an en-suite bathroom (with a bathtub in some rooms) · step up to the Triple with Balcony or the Super King Balcony Double (~31 sqm) and you get the private outdoor space that makes the hotel worth choosing over its neighbours · a Family Suite is available for larger groups needing more room · the decor runs a dark boutique-industrial line — brick-effect walls, wood floors, and furniture in deep tones that give the rooms a personality beyond the generic · real reviews mostly agree that rooms are clean, with comfortable beds and functional air-conditioning · the honest caveat: the building has age on it, and room condition is not perfectly uniform — some units have minor wear on fittings, low water pressure, or windows that are not fully soundproof · requesting a higher floor and confirming a balcony room at booking time takes care of most of this.

Pool, parking, and facilities — the two facilities that most distinguish White Palace are its outdoor pool and free in-building parking · the pool is not a grand resort-scale affair, but it is a real pool, not too crowded given the hotel's size, and perfectly adequate for an evening dip after a long hospital day · the parking garage is comfortable to use, well-signed, and free for the duration of your stay — in a central Bangkok neighbourhood where parking can easily add ฿200–400 a day, that saving adds up over a week · there is an on-site massage service that longer-stay guests use regularly · free Wi-Fi throughout, a 24-hour front desk, and a tour-booking desk for excursions · be aware that breakfast is not included in the standard room rate — you will need to order it separately or head out, which is no hardship because the Victory Monument area is full of cheap and good Thai breakfast spots within a few minutes' walk · one other thing worth knowing: there is a ฿2,000 refundable security deposit collected at check-in (returned at check-out), so have a card or cash ready.

What real reviews say — the honest picture — pulling from Trip.com, Booking.com and TripAdvisor, the pattern is consistent · Praise centres on: the location close to Victory Monument and Pratunam markets, the private balconies that guests describe as rare and genuinely enjoyable, the pool, the free parking, friendly staff who speak both Thai and English, and room sizes that feel generous for the money · Recurring criticisms: the building shows its age in some rooms — a few guests have reported pest issues (cockroaches, particularly on lower floors), low water pressure in bathrooms, road noise on the street-facing side, housekeeping that is not on a full 24-hour rolling service (you need to request it), and the ฿2,000 deposit that some guests find steep relative to the room rate · the pattern in the negative reviews suggests that floors 4 and above are less affected by street noise and pests, so it is worth asking for a higher floor when you book.

"The Triple room was huge — three of us shared it and it felt spacious, not cramped at all. Having a balcony to sit on in the evenings made a real difference when you spend all day at the hospital. Free parking sealed the deal because we drove down from the north."

Price and value — standard rates for the Superior Room start at around ฿1,280/night in quieter periods, and the Triple with Balcony and Super King Balcony Double run roughly ฿1,700–1,900 in mid-range season · during long public holidays or peak periods expect prices to nudge up toward ฿2,000–2,500 for the balcony rooms · set those numbers against what the same budget gets you at nearby hotels — which is typically a standard room with no balcony, no pool, and pay-per-day parking — and the value case for White Palace becomes clear · the key is to book a balcony room, since that is the feature that justifies choosing it over cheaper neighbours on the same street.

Things to know before you book — a few practical notes that make the stay smoother · one: always request a room with balcony (the Triple with Balcony or Super King Balcony Double) at booking time — not every room has one · two: prepare ฿2,000 for the check-in deposit by card or cash — it is returned at check-out · three: breakfast is not included, but good and affordable Thai-breakfast spots are within a 5-minute walk around Victory Monument · four: ask for a room on floor 4 or above to reduce street noise and the slim risk of pests · five: before driving to Rajavithi, confirm which building or outpatient department you need — the campus is large and finding the right entrance saves time.

highlights.title: 1.1 km from Rajavithi — 6-min drive
highlights.text: Rajavithi Hospital and the Children's Hospital are 1.1 km away, a 6-minute drive or about a 15-minute walk. The hotel's free parking makes daily hospital runs simple and cost-free.

highlights.title: Private balconies + outdoor pool
highlights.text: Many rooms come with a private balcony — extremely rare at this price in Bangkok. There is also an outdoor pool for unwinding after a long hospital day, without leaving the hotel.

highlights.title: Free in-building parking
highlights.text: The hotel provides free parking in its own garage. In central Bangkok where parking typically costs ฿200–400/day, this perk can save a significant amount over a multi-night stay.

pros: Good location near Victory Monument and Pratunam, easy to find food and run errands
Spacious rooms, many with private balconies — rare at this price in Bangkok
Free in-building parking, a significant saving for guests who drive
Friendly, helpful staff who speak Thai and English well
cons: Older building with uneven room condition; a few reports of pests in lower-floor rooms
Low water pressure in some rooms; street-facing rooms pick up road noise

pros: Private balconies and an outdoor pool that set it apart from similar-priced hotels nearby
Free parking is a genuine advantage for guests arriving by car

honestSummary: White Palace Hotel Bangkok is the best match in the area for anyone who needs a hotel near Rajavithi Hospital with a private balcony, pool, and free parking under ฿2,000/night — but the building has age to it and room quality is not perfectly consistent; request a high floor and a balcony room when booking.
honestChecks: If pest issues are a serious concern for you — a handful of reviews mention cockroaches on lower floors. Request floor 4 or above and flag it when you check in to be safe.
If walking distance to Rajavithi is the top priority — VIX Bangkok (315 m), fyn hotel (700 m) and Yello Rooms (700 m) are all closer walks if you don't need a car or a pool.

If you expect full international 4-star standards in every detail — the hotel has the amenities and the style, but the building is aging and finishes vary room to room; manage expectations accordingly.

tips.title: Plan your Rajavithi route
tips.body: The hospital is 1.1 km away. Grab or taxi takes about 6 minutes. Walking via Ratchawithi Road takes around 15 minutes. Check which building or outpatient department you need before you go — the campus is large.

tips.title: Always book a balcony room
tips.body: Not every room has a balcony. Specify 'Triple with Balcony' or 'Super King Balcony Double' at booking. The balcony is the single feature that makes White Palace stand out from every other hotel at this price on the street.

tips.title: Prepare the ฿2,000 check-in deposit
tips.body: The hotel collects a ฿2,000 refundable security deposit at check-in (returned at check-out). Have a credit card or cash ready — it takes some guests by surprise and can slow down check-in.

tips.title: Breakfast is not included — plenty nearby
tips.body: Standard rooms do not include breakfast. The Victory Monument area has dozens of Thai breakfast spots within a 5-minute walk: congee stalls, boat noodles, rice and curry shops — cheap, good and very close.

info.v: Free in all rooms and public areas

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — White Palace Hotel Bangkok

faq.q: Where is White Palace Hotel Bangkok and how far is it from Rajavithi Hospital?
faq.a: The hotel is at 40 Soi Petchburi 15 (Somprasong 3), Ratchathewi District, Bangkok 10400 · it is 1.1 km from Rajavithi Hospital and the adjacent Queen Sirikit National Institute of Child Health (the Children's Hospital) — about a 6-minute drive or Grab ride, or roughly a 15-minute walk along Ratchawithi Road · BTS Victory Monument is about 1 km away, and BTS Phaya Thai connects to the Airport Rail Link for Suvarnabhumi.

faq.q: Does White Palace Hotel Bangkok have a pool and free parking?
faq.a: Yes to both · there is an outdoor swimming pool for guests, and free in-building parking is available · the free parking is a particularly valuable perk in central Bangkok, where parking typically costs ฿200–400 per day · it is one of the main reasons guests who drive in choose this hotel over alternatives in the area.

faq.q: Do the rooms at White Palace have private balconies?
faq.a: Many rooms have a private balcony, in particular the Triple with Balcony and the Super King Balcony Double (~31 sqm) · this is genuinely rare for the price range in Bangkok, and it is the hotel's standout feature · always specify a balcony room when booking — not every room has one, so it is worth making this explicit.

faq.q: What does White Palace Hotel Bangkok cost and which room is best value?
faq.a: The Superior Room starts at around ฿1,280/night in mid-season · the Triple with Balcony runs roughly ฿1,700 and the Super King Balcony Double about ฿1,900 · prices rise during Thai public holidays and peak season · for most guests, the Triple with Balcony is the best value — it handles 2–3 people, the per-person cost is low, and the private terrace is the feature that makes the hotel worth choosing over cheaper options.

faq.q: Is White Palace Hotel Bangkok suitable for families visiting a patient at Rajavithi?
faq.a: It suits this purpose well, especially for families who drive in (free parking), have two or three people sharing a room (Triple with Balcony keeps costs low), and want somewhere to genuinely relax rather than just sleep between hospital visits · the pool and the private balcony make a multi-day stay more comfortable · if your priority is the shortest possible walk to Rajavithi without a car, VIX Bangkok (315 m) or fyn hotel (700 m) are closer on foot.
